regime_context: Cross-sectional momentum on US themes is still an attention lens, not alpha, but the absolute-trend gate DOES help here (gate_helps=true), so trend discipline is a legitimate de-risking input. Leadership is narrowly concentrated in AI/semis (eligible=21/49, breadth_of_rotation view='narrowing', one_narrative=false) with rotation_timing display-only; a small hit-rate/dir-accuracy record (n=85, hit 0.68, dir 0.49) argues for low conviction overall.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the AI/semi cluster consolidates into a single leadership handoff or broadens out: the rotation radar shows a narrowing eligible set (21/49) with AI Infra leading Cybersecurity by 0.651, so I am watching for Cybersecurity's breadth (1.0) to hold while its crowding_z cools below ~1.5 — that would mark a cleaner, less-extended challenger in an intact AI-adjacent uptrend. The watch retires if CIBR's breadth breaks below 0.7 or AI Infra's score re-widens its lead above ~0.9.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank 2, trend-gate eligible, and the ONLY top trend-health theme showing near-perfect breadth (1.0) with a 'trend' hurst tag and the highest durability_bar (0.85) in the top tier. CIBR is scorable. The crowding_z of 1.95 (crowded=true) is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade — the guardrails explicitly forbid fading a leader on crowding and allow a checkable conditional lean when trend-health is strong.
evidence: breadth 1.0 and hurst_tag 'trend' — cohesion/intactness among the strongest
durability_bar 0.85, highest among top eligible themes
crowding_z 1.95 — treat as cap-only, not a fade
theses.dissent: The crowding flag at ~2z and its rank-2 placement right behind AI Infra may mark a short-term inflow/attention spike (the reader contract warns attention spikes mark tops); rank-IC ~0 means the momentum rank itself has no return edge.

falsifier.text: CIBR loses at least 5% to SPY and its breadth among constituents falls below 0.7 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
theses.thesis: WFE (semicap_equipment) sits rank 3, trend-gate eligible, with a 'trend' hurst tag, strong breadth (0.938), high durability_bar (0.79), and NOT crowded (z=0.86). It is part of the AI/semi leadership cluster but, unlike Cybersecurity, lacks the crowding caution, so the trend gate aligns cleanly with a durable, broad uptrend. SMH is scorable.
theses.dissent: It shares the SMH proxy with AI Infrastructure and AI Semiconductors, so the 'theme' may largely be one concentrated semiconductor complex rather than an independent source of leadership; a single AI-capex air pocket could hit all of them together.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms SPY by 5% or its share of names above the trend gate drops below 50% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is rank 5 but ineligible (trend-gate OFF) with near-zero breadth (0.125), a 'mean-revert' hurst tag, and the weakest durability_bar in the top cohort (0.14). This is the one validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — saying the theme is NOT in a durable uptrend; it mean-reverts. Avoid until the gate flips eligible.
evidence: crowding_z -0.05 (not crowded — no crowding caution applies)
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting low-breadth themes can snap back sharply, especially in a macro-geopolitics headline regime (macro_narrative shows geopolitics in dominant themes); a silver squeeze could force a re-entry higher.

falsifier.text: SIL becomes trend-gate eligible AND its breadth rises above 0.6 while holding its top-10 rank before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
